But he can!  Not with one Haka of Battle, but you can draw your entire deck, discard it HoB, reshuffle and draw it again, discard it to another HoB, and repeat until he has a +999999 to damage.

posts.name: NineEdgeFirst
posts.cooked:
Shouldn't Parse be able to ruin Gloomweaver's day by throwing all his relics in the trash with just Extrasensory Awareness?

With enough setup time, Parse can also hit for staggering amounts of damage by way of multiple Critical Multipliers and repeated discard effects (Recompile, Gauge, Snap Decision, Segmentation Fault).

Super Scientific Tachyon could also toss all of Gloomy's relics for him, but it'd take a lot more luck for her to pull it off.
